data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for handling and viewing PDF files.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin for handling PDF files that supports loading from assets, URLs, or local files on Android and iOS. It includes a pre-built PDF viewer widget to display pages and supports custom page loading and zooming.
use_when: You need to display PDF documents within an Android or iOS Flutter application.
You want a pre-built PDF viewer widget with built-in navigation and controls.
You need to load PDFs from assets, URLs, or local files.
avoid_when: You need support for desktop or web platforms.
You require complex PDF editing or form-filling capabilities.
strengths: Supports loading PDFs from multiple sources (assets, URLs, and files).
Includes a pre-built PDF viewer widget for quick integration.
Requires no special native permissions on Android or iOS.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms.
No advanced PDF editing capabilities documented.
data.setup_notes: No permissions required for Android or iOS. Uses application cache directory.
data.minimal_example:
PDFDocument doc = await PDFDocument.fromAsset('assets/test.pdf');
PDFViewer viewer = PDFViewer(document: document);
